implementation PR base, head, changed paths, required check, review, or actionable feedback changes
merge SHA, protected main, post-merge required health, CD containment, cleanup, closeout, or R2-promotion identity changes
success-closeout containment or exact-main health failure
any failure-closeout, exact revert, executed CD step, incident state, or successor promotion after failure

acceptanceMatrix.expected: four-zone trust, exact attestation/receipt, exact-origin token confinement, first-request TTFB ordering, complete served-JavaScript closure, independent recomputation, and every false-PASS adversary pass with no skips

acceptanceMatrix.command: observe one exact-head GitHub-hosted required-check and terminal-feedback rollup without dispatching the new workflow
acceptanceMatrix.expected: all required current-head checks pass, Git Preview/provider/OIDC/runtime remain inert, and actionable or unresolved feedback is zero

acceptanceMatrix.command: merge only the exact reviewed head, contain only its exact automatic CD before executable steps, and verify exact-main health and preauthorized R2 promotion
acceptanceMatrix.expected: protected main equals the exact merge, health is green, CD has no runner or executed step, only exact refs are cleaned, and the closeout leaves runtime unauthorized awaiting one exact R2; any adverse implementation/transition/containment/main-health result uses only the blocked failure closeout and cannot satisfy this success criterion

recompute the unchanged score, gzip, and first-request TTFB verdict

closureEvidence.callers: the one new workflow is the sole future dispatch entry and every helper call/import is explicit
closureEvidence.sharedConsumers: one exact R2 consumes all three merged child slices
closureEvidence.readWriteDelete: artifacts, attestation, receipt, evidence, temporary state, terminal cleanup, and exact refs are enumerated
closureEvidence.mountErrorPaths: runner, attestation, environment, provider, OIDC, Chrome, network, evidence, and verifier failures stop closed

highestRiskCases: a permission, secret, attestation, candidate byte, or token crosses a trust zone
OIDC reaches a redirect, frame, worker, or third-party subresource
a duplicate or wrong deployment/receipt/artifact/source is selected
served JavaScript is missing, duplicated, mutable, or not matched to the attested local counterpart
a dynamic HTML or unrelated non-JavaScript byte is falsely claimed attested
a threshold or timing method changes
the workflow is dispatched during this inert slice
a post-merge failure leaves runtime_authorized true or a successor promoted
a runner assignment or executed CD step is mislabeled as zero provider state
a failure closeout, exact revert, or successor action exceeds its one-shot ceiling

rollback.mechanism: delete only an unmerged exact branch; use at most one separately reviewed mechanical exact-revert PR only while the implementation merge is the most recent merge touching its writer paths and only as temporary containment; once a success transition merges, removal of either merge requires separate incident/revert authority after the mandatory child-specific failure-closeout PR; that closeout sets runtime_authorized false, activeSlice null, and all successors blocked, and inability to merge it stops for blocked current-authority incident repair without retry
rollback.trigger: any unauthorized writer, contract ambiguity, line breach, test skip, current-head finding, required-check failure, merge/main regression, workflow dispatch before R2, provider activity before R2, CD-containment failure, cleanup failure, or successor promotion without the full success chain
rollback.containmentFailure: if any CD runner or step executes, preserve exact evidence, mark provider/runtime state unknown, merge only the deauthorizing failure closeout when safe, and stop for separate incident authority

firstImplementationAction: add RED workflow-zone, browser/OIDC, collector-ordering, and independent evidence/verdict contracts before the orchestration workflow or production helpers are written

failurePolicy.exactRevertScope: implementation merge only while it is the most recent merge touching its writer paths and its success transition has not merged, as temporary containment before mandatory failure closeout
failurePolicy.failedChildDefinition: the child whose active implementation/governance attempt, implementation PR or merge, or success-transition PR or merge is the failing or invalidated stage; after promotion attribution remains with that predecessor and never shifts to the successor
failurePolicy.mergedSuccessCloseoutDisposition: the failure closeout names the exact success-closeout path and merge SHA and marks it superseded and non-promoting without editing it
failurePolicy.executedCdStep: record containment_failure, preserve evidence, provider state unknown, stop for incident authority
